title: EB / laser welding of rib-skin assembly
description: EB / laser welding of rib-skin assembly capability for titanium components
processDescription: Laser beam welding of titanium uses a focused fiber laser to create deep, narrow welds with minimal heat input. Keyhole mode welding achieves depth-to-width ratios up to 10:1, specifically for titanium components. Precision titanium components  present unique challenges: Balancing dimensional accuracy with cost per part. Process selection (mill vs. turn vs. EDM vs. laser) optimized for each feature.
heatControl: Argon shielding at weld zone and trailing shield. Interpass temperature kept below 100 C.
flatnessControl: Vacuum or magnetic fixturing for thin-gauge weldments.
capabilitiesDescription: Certified welding capability for EB / laser welding of rib-skin assembly, with full inert gas shielding, weld procedure qualification, and operator certification.
